Definition: properly, like this, i.e. by implication, (of manner) thus (or so); also (of place) here (or hither); or (of time) now
BiblicalUsage: Koh is the little word thus, so, here, now. Genesis 15:5 has God saying, so shall thy seed be, as the stars, Exodus 2:12 has Moses looking this way and that way before he slew the Egyptian, and Numbers 6:23 has God telling Aaron, on this wise ye shall bless the children of Israel.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe thus is the word God uses when He gives the pattern: so shall thy seed be, on this wise ye shall bless, and the blessing has been spoken the same way ever since.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
